title: Canonicalize Stability Matrix interactive lifecycle and native-worker promotion boundaries
decisions: Stability Matrix is REQ-ADAPTER plus PRIMARY-REF for interactive local generative-media lifecycle, not an FA3 control plane or hard runtime dependency.
The graphical application runs as a systemd user service; maintenance trials and production native workers are separate execution modes.
Production packages run as isolated native ai-media worker units controlled by existing Temporal, NATS, HRB, security and evidence authorities.
GPU and NUMA placement is discovered dynamically and bound by PCI identity plus GPU UUID through a fail-closed compute-role lease; GPU model and count are never canonical constants.
Package-owned isolated environments, immutable revisions, hashes, manifests, maintenance lock, drain, checkpoint, smoke, memory-envelope, output and rollback evidence are mandatory.
Provider SQLite or JSON state remains operator-local and non-canonical; PostgreSQL and the existing artifact/model registry remain canonical authorities.
Provider failure cannot stop already promoted native workers; damaged environments are isolated and clean uninstall plus orphan scan is required.
Reference regression PASS does not claim current-host production worker E2E or global runtime promotion.
